title: Script Editor margin regression
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5.dev4 and all later versions up to the latest snapshot (currently 4.7.dev1)
- Not reproducible in: 4.5.dev3 and earlier snapshots (e.g. 4.4.1, 4.4, 4.3)
- **Bisecting result: Commit 1794098b47a42237452963bb6a641cfe6af46a15**: "[TextEdit] Fix margin rounding at sub 100% scale."

### System information

Windows 11 25H2 - Godot v4.5.1.stable, v4.6.1.stable - Vulkan (Forward+) - AMD Ryzen 7 8700G with integrated AMD Radeon 780M Graphics & macOS Sequoia 15.7.4 on MacBook Air M1 2020

### Issue description

## Occurrence
- Using some custom display scales. Positive tested ones: 1.1, 1.3, 1.5, 1.6, 1.7, 1.8, 2.1, 2.2, 2.5, 2.8, 2.9.
- On various screen resolutions on different monitors and computers.

## Bug Description
The **last character** of the longest code line in the Script Editor **is hidden**, if the line is longer then the Script Editor's CodeEdit's width.
Instead, there is a small empty space which can be selected to select the last char. But you'll never see the very last char of the line.

## Expected vs Actual Behavior
The char should be visible.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2fcfd093-360f-4fff-8183-616b6051a6be)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/102e3e26-66e3-4bfa-a309-e4c3ce6c8a22)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Set `interface/editor/display_scale` in the Editor Settings to `Custom`.
2. Set `interface/editor/custom_display_scale` in the Editor Settings to `2.2` (or one of the listed ones in the issue description).
3. Open the Script Editor.
4. Type a line that is longer than the Script Editor's width and every other line in this script.
5. Scroll to the line's end: the last character shouldn't be visible.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[new-game-project-(4.5.1).zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25550177/new-game-project-.4.5.1.zip)
[new-game-project-(4.6.1).zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25550178/new-game-project-.4.6.1.zip)
